answer: Cap new identities with a weekly slot auction no farm can flood. First, the network mints only 100 identity slots each week by Dutch auction; the clearing price sets a bond refundable after 180 honest days. Second, each slot binds to one phone-verified human and one device, so a meadow of clones needs 100 separate winning bids. Third, a slot caught cheating loses its bond and is re-auctioned. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 100 auctions at $60 a slot, $600,000, plus 100 weeks of waiting. Like a pearl forming grain by grain, trust grows slowly; a gale of fakes shatters against a closed gate.
